release_gate: Verdicts, in order and never conflated: INPUTS_INCOMPLETE -> INPUTS_COMPLETE_NOT_RELEASE_GRADE (vendor_nominal/model_assumption rows remain) -> REQUIREMENTS_FAILED -> REQUIREMENTS_EVALUATED. Geometry match and physical validation are separate gates. A CAD collision check does not prove structural stability or prop containment.

clauses.requirement: Fixture motor plate hole coordinates equal the measured EX1103 pattern (pitch circle, hole diameter) within the drawing tolerance

release_requirement.motor_mount_pitch_circle: Owner supplies dimensioned drawing or measured hole coordinates
release_requirement.motor_mount_hole_diameter: Owner supplies thread size and fit with uncertainty

clauses.verification: Dimensioned drawing or measured hole coordinates with uncertainty

clauses.requirement: Screw penetration into the motor bell is at or below the safe depth and at or above the minimum engagement, across the plate + adapter stack

release_requirement.motor_mount_thread_engagement: Owner confirms safe screw penetration and mounting plate stack

clauses.verification: Owner confirms safe penetration; stack drawing lists every plate/washer thickness

clauses.requirement: Prop hub bore and T-mount screw spacing match the delivered bell; hub bore equals shaft nominal until the delivered shaft is measured

release_requirement.prop_mount_screw_spacing: Owner supplies matching bell and prop hub drawing or inspection
release_requirement.prop_hub_fit_tolerance: Owner chooses the bore-to-shaft fit tolerance with a stated design basis (fit class, retention method, vendor drawing); an unchosen tolerance is not 0.05 mm by default

clauses.note: Vendor-nominal bore/shaft are planning values; the mating fit is confirmed only by measuring the delivered shaft and hub.

clauses.requirement: Both load-cell end interfaces (mount spacing, thread, orientation) match the identified, calibrated cell revision

release_requirement.load_cell_mount_spacing: Select and identify calibrated load cell then record both end interfaces
release_requirement.load_cell_capacity: Owner selects overload capacity and source drawing

clauses.verification: Engineering Data/instrumentation.csv names the cell; its drawing is the source

clauses.requirement: Fixture base anchor pattern equals the measured bench mounting and the documented stability/load path

release_requirement.stand_anchor_spacing: Measure actual bench mounting and document stability/load path

clauses.requirement: No fixture, cable or guard element lies inside the static prop swept disc of diameter prop_diameter about the motor axis
clauses.note: STATIC envelope only. Dynamic clearance (blade flap, whirl) and containment envelope are a separately approved addition per the register's release requirement, NOT derived here.

clauses.requirement: Motor keep-out cylinder D x L; the only solid cad/generate.py produces today
clauses.note: Envelope only (vendor nominal); no mount features are modelled until the pattern is measured.

clauses.requirement: Load-cell deflection at predicted peak load plus dead load does not close any clearance to a hard stop or preload path

release_requirement.load_cell_capacity: Owner selects overload capacity and source drawing

clauses.note: Model peak thrust 4.2 N is a planning value (model_assumption); the cell's stiffness comes from its drawing once identified.

clauses.requirement: Thrust axis passes through the load-cell sensitive axis; offset recorded, off-axis moment bounded, never bypassing the cell

release_requirement.load_cell_mount_spacing: Select and identify calibrated load cell then record both end interfaces

clauses.verification: Interface coordinates in the machine-readable report; cable and containment attachments traced

clauses.requirement: Cell capacity exceeds dead load + predicted peak thrust + reaction transients with the owner-selected overload margin

release_requirement.load_cell_capacity: Owner selects overload capacity and source drawing

clauses.formula: capacity >= margin * (dead_load + peak_thrust); margin is an owner decision
clauses.note: Planning peak thrust 4.2 N total (model_assumption, per-motor share is a design decision). Dead load and predicted peak are to be recorded separately.

clauses.requirement: If a lever-type calibration is used, the perpendicular pivot-to-force-line distance is calibrated and distinct from the vehicle authority arm

release_requirement.stand_calibration_lever: Calibrate perpendicular distance from pivot to calibration-force line
release_requirement.authority_arm_measured: Measure vehicle center-to-motor radius separately from stand calibration lever

clauses.verification: docs/specs/measured-authority-gate/evidence-contract.md: arm_m is measured separately from stand calibration

clauses.requirement: The expanded thrust uncertainty artifact exists and covers calibration, alignment and dead-load subtraction before any authority number is computed

release_requirement.thrust_expanded_uncertainty: Reviewed calibration and uncertainty artifact required

evidence_note: Derived from the register on the stated version; no fixture STEP exists; nothing here authorises fabrication, spending, pressurisation or rotor operation.
